profile.structure_status: Borrowed documented family structure; sources S10/S18/D03/D04/O08 and mission-specifications.md. This does not reproduce a particular live-server generator.
profile.destination_selection: Freeze one seeded reachable non-origin system with shortest-hop route <=3 jumps; use its main orbital station. No surface endpoints.
profile.requirements: No commodity hold requirement for encrypted-data variant. Physical package variant requires one free tonne and uses a distinct saved variant ID.

profile.reward_rule: Frozen base[difficulty-1] + 300*requiredRouteHops; only one reward transaction at final handoff. No extra per-kill payment unless engine bounty independently applies.
profile.save_contract: Persist profile/version, accepted seed, origin/destination/route, deadline/clock domain, unique objective/cargo/passenger/entity IDs, progress/outcomes and all reward/transfer IDs. Never reroll an accepted job.
profile.station_handoff: Replace original surface endpoint/stage with explicit station-handoff-specifications.md mapping; no ground simulation.
profile.retry: Failed/abandoned instance stays terminal. New station offer receives a new identity; no recovery of already granted/consumed reward IDs.

seed_contract.initial_state: Stored nonzero UInt32; zero input maps to0x6D2B79F5. Use unsigned32-bit wrapping after every operation.
seed_contract.next: state ^= state <<13; state ^= state >>17; state ^= state <<5; mask to32 bits after each step.
seed_contract.choice: floor(unitInterval *candidateCount), from candidates sorted by stable system/entity ID.
seed_contract.freeze: Store all choices on offer generation and all accepted parameters; no time-based/reroll draw during completion.

common.common_clock: Persistent project game-clock seconds; paused menus/paused game do not advance deadlines. Flight/witchspace/service simulation advances by the project clock. Deadline success requires confirmation time <=deadline.
common.money: Store integer decicredits. Convert displayed common credit values by*10; round estimated reward formulas once at generation.
common.common_acceptance: Only offer/accept when all stated equipment/cargo/berth requirements can be satisfied and a reachable orbital destination exists. Back changes nothing. Acceptance, custody and completion/payment are atomic once-only GameRuntime transactions.
common.common_hull_switch: Preserve accepted mission IDs/state and unique equipment/items. Store incompatible personal equipment; block hull switch if required mission cargo/passengers cannot fit. No free missile refill.
common.common_failure: Terminal failure releases outstanding station obligations and removes only owned mission encounter markers/unused grants. Already expended ammunition and legitimate engine bounties are not rolled back. No extra cash penalty unless the profile states one.

maximum_route_hops.reason: Common space encounter adapter requires an explicit placement/trigger bound; no exact original distribution established.
